item.title: 'Portrait of a Heist:' A look back at 1978 Christmas Eve burglary at SF's de Young Museum
item.description: 'Twas night before Christmas when all through the de Young Museum, not a person was stirring, not even a mouse... until thieves broke in through a skylight and made off with several valuable paintings. In ABC7 Originals' "Portrait of a Heist," we look back at San Francisco's most notorious art heist.

item.title: SF apartment management staff accused of breaking in, stealing Christmas gifts from tenants: VIDEO
item.description: Days before Christmas, tenants at one apartment complex in San Francisco are accusing members of their property management staff of breaking into their home and stealing Christmas gifts. "Sad just to see the spirit of Christmas just kind of robbed. It was, like it was the Grinch."
